name: my-blog

scripts.//dev: build and migrate first: neither dist/ (assets.directory) nor the local D1 is in git, so a fresh clone has neither. Without them wrangler refuses to start, or the public pages 500 with D1_ERROR: no such table
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev
scripts.//build: merge what gets served into dist/. wrangler.jsonc points assets.directory at it, so dev and deploy both need it. lily-assets ships with @kanf/lily
scripts.//deploy: every deploy after the first. Migrations run before wrangler deploy, so new code never meets an old schema
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy
scripts.//deploy:first: the first deploy only. D1 and R2 are created from the bindings during wrangler deploy, so there is nothing to migrate until it has run once
scripts.deploy:first: npm run build && wrangler deploy && npm run db:migrate

//dependencies: the CMS itself. The admin UI, the migrations and lily-assets all ship inside it, so this is the only one
